verdict.why: Left shows the brief's defining features: a dark tiled hipped-and-gabled roof with upturned eave corners, a raised timber floor on stone footings, lanterns, and a garden setting with stepping stones and greenery. Right is a monolithic stepped pyramid in one dark timber tone with no curved eaves, no visible paper screens, and no garden context, so it reads more like a pagoda or ziggurat than a tea house.
